description: Take your data out as a file. It opens in Excel or Google Sheets. Only you, the owner, can download it. Every download is noted in Who changed what.
file_help: Amounts are in rupees. Times are India time.
download_help: A file with every row of this list, not only this page.

customers.title: Customers
customers.help: Every customer: code, name, phone, area, due and advance.

bills.title: Bills
bills.help: Every bill of the months you choose: amount, paid and still due.

payments.title: Payments
payments.help: Every payment of the days you choose. Cash and UPI in separate columns.

dues.title: Due list
dues.help: Who owes money, how much and since when.

collections.title: Daily collection
collections.help: Cash and UPI each person took, day by day.

handover.title: Cash handover
handover.help: Cash each lineman handed over, and any difference.

connections.title: Connections
connections.help: Every connection on a day: status and monthly rent.

billing_runs.title: Bill run
billing_runs.help: Every customer the month's bill run looked at, and what happened.

problem.bad_filters: These days or months can't be downloaded. Choose other days and try again.
problem.not_found: Something you chose was not found. Choose again and try again.
problem.too_many: You downloaded many files just now. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
problem.failed: The file could not be made. Try again.

forbidden: Only the owner can download data.
truncated: This file stops here: it has the first {count} rows only. Choose fewer days or months.
